mods.name: AFRoads Construction
mods.description:
为Minecraft加入了大量道路建筑方块与设施.
点缀你的城建世界！

A large number of road building blocks and facilities for Minecraft.
Decorate your world of urban and road construction!

item: Please use for TOP/BOTTOM slab to change the state.
§4§lRoad tool(Attribute)
§4§lRoad tool(Link)
§4§lRoad tool(state)
§8§oAutomatically connect to other pillars.
§8§oJust a manhole cover.
§8§oJust a road seam.
§8§oStop and stop.
§8§oThe basic material of roads.
§8§oThen you can click a Traffic light to link the control box selected.
§8§oThis is a part of gray insulation panels.
§8§oThis is a traffic light!Automatically convert colors at intervals.
§8§oUse the Road tool(link) to change the normal/bracket mode..
§8§oUse the Road tool(link) to link Traffic Lights Control Box.
§8§oUse the Road tool(link) to select one Traffic Lights Control Box.
§8§oUse the Road tool(state) to change the cold/warm light.
§8§oUse the Road tool(state) to change the large/mini mode..
§8§oUse the Road tool(state) to change the normal/timer mode.
§8§oUse the Road tool(state) to change the normal/turn mode.
§8§oUse the Road tool(state) to change the white/yellow mode.
§8§oUse the Road tool(state) to open text settings.
